literal: Suitable opportunity if seen, for striking anvil, not agreeing those who associate friendship.
translation: The friendship of those who outwardly associate but inwardly disagree is like an anvil, supporting you only to strike when the right opportunity arises.
modern: மனத்தால் பொருந்தாமல் வெளியளவில் நெருங்கிப் பழகும் பகைவரின் நட்பானது, தக்க சமயம் கிடைக்கும்போது வெட்டுவதற்குத் தாங்கும் பட்டடையைப் போன்றதாகும்.
explanation: This couplet warns against false friends who outwardly act close but inwardly harbor enmity. Their friendship is compared to an anvil used by a blacksmith. Just as the anvil supports the metal only so it can be struck with a hammer, these false friends support you only until they find the right opportunity to strike and ruin you.
